card.title: IPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max – No Touch Fix

source.title: IPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max – No Touch Fix

claims.statement: iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max no touch can be IO_AP_TOUCH_BSYNC1 at display connector J11800 reading OL (open) or near 0 (shorted inside the CPU).
Fix in both cases is a jumper from IO_AOP_TO_ALS_BSYNC2_CONN on the front prox connector J11100 to the display side of the line (isolating the shorted pad if shorted).

procedure: If OL: jumper from IO_AOP_TO_ALS_BSYNC2_CONN (J11100) to the filter pad output.
If shorted: isolate the J11800 pad, jumper from J11100 to J11800.
card.caveats: Source labels the prox connector as both C11147 and J11100. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
